newsitem.title: USA: ASV to launch new track utility vehicle.
newsitem.headline: ASV to launch new track utility vehicle.

text.p: ASV Inc said Thursday it will introduce its latest rubber-tracked vehicle for trail grooming and utility work markets tomorrow.
ASV President Gary Lemke said the vehicle, which currently goes by the generic name 125-HD, will retail for about $75,000 when it arrives on the market this fall.
The new vehicle does not have any grease fittings on its undercarriage, a feature ASV said will reduce maintenance chores on the part of the operator, ASV said.
ASV develops track-driven, all-season vehicles and related accessories. Its shares closed down 5/8 Thursday at 21-5/8.
